Vertical SaaS for the property trades (insurance claims estimation, roofing/exterior contractor software) whose delivery has stalled on legacy mobile-and-desktop codebases — manual releases, 40+ hour cycle times, pre-AI SDLC — fixed via an instrumented AI-native engineering transformation he has run before (42h to <20h cycle time, +115% PRs/dev, 98% faster releases; self-reported).
EDP: An org at ~42-hour cycle times with manual releases ships roughly half the work per engineer of a DORA-elite AI-native peer, silently burning ~$1.8M/year of paid capacity per 20 engineers until a faster competitor takes the roadmap and the category.
